title: Bounded Self-Improvement Designs — Bounding What Can Change
titleKn: ಮಿತಿಯುಳ್ಳ ಸ್ವ-ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ — ಏನು ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು ಮಿತಿಗೊಳಿಸಿ
desc: A bounded design lets a system improve only designated parts, with protected components it cannot edit.
objectives: Identify components that must be immutable.

title: Bounded Self-Improvement Designs — Gated Promotion of Changes

desc: Candidate improvements should pass tests, safety evaluations and often human review before being adopted.

title: Bounded Self-Improvement Designs — Monitoring and Stopping
titleKn: ಮಿತಿಯುಳ್ಳ ಸ್ವ-ಸುಧಾರಣೆ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ — ನಿಗಾ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುವುದು
desc: Bounded systems need logs, anomaly detection and a reliable way to halt improvement.
builderEn: [{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Bounded Self-Improvement Designs — Monitoring and Stopping","textKn":"Bounded Self-Improvement Designs — Monitoring and Stopping","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 3 of 3 in Bounded Self-Improvement Designs","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 3 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Full Logging","headingKn":"ಪೂರ್ಣ ಲಾಗಿಂಗ್","bodyEn":"Record every proposed and adopted change with its evaluation results, so humans can audit what the system did and why.","bodyKn":"ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾವಿತ ಮತ್ತು ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದೊಂದಿಗೆ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ; ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಏನು, ಏಕೆ ಮಾಡಿತು ಎಂದು ಮಾನವರು ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧಿಸಬಹುದು."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Halt Conditions","headingKn":"ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುವ ಷರತ್ತು","bodyEn":"Decide beforehand what triggers a stop: unexpected behaviour, evaluation drops or attempts to touch protected parts.
